|game_text=Deploy on opponent's location. Your Force drains here cannot be modified or canceled by opponent. Wherever you have two Mistryl, your Force drains are +1. 'Stolen' on [[Swilla Corey]] is treated as 'placed in owner's Used Pile' and it may target a weapon instead of a device.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Dark Reconnaissance]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB4-21-Dark_Reconnaissance-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Virtual Block 4 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Dark Reconnaissance]].
* '''Original''' ([[Dark Reconnaissance]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on opponent’s location. Wherever you have two Mistryl, your Force drains are +1. “Stolen” on Swilla Corey is treated as “placed in owner’s Used Pile” and it may target a weapon instead of a device. Your Force drains here cannot be modified or canceled by opponent.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Dark Reconnaissance (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) moved the last sentence (“Your Force drains here …”) to second place and set the quotations in single quotation marks: “Deploy on opponent's location. Your Force drains here cannot be modified or canceled by opponent. Wherever you have two Mistryl, your Force drains are +1. 'Stolen' on Swilla Corey is treated as 'placed in owner's Used Pile' and it may target a weapon instead of a device.”.<ref name="cl-1240_20-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
